stories.headline: Bitcoin Core Details Three Fixed Security Flaws
stories.summary: October 2025 updates fixed two medium severity flaws and a severe issue that could stop mining node block production.
stories.originalTitle: Bitcoin Core discloses three patched security bugs

stories.headline: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for European institutions
stories.summary: The service holds Bitcoin, Ether, and three stablecoins, while establishing a tokenization agreement with Deutsche Asset Management.
stories.originalTitle: Deutsche Bank starts crypto custody for institutional clients

stories.headline: MSCI to Remove Strategy, Metaplanet, and Upexi From Indexes
stories.summary: The index provider will implement these changes following the market close on November 30.
stories.originalTitle: MSCI deletes Strategy from indexes at November close
